pending.question: Is the short free-standing vertical tick after each final ה a paseq or a print artifact?

pending.question: Is the accent merkha or tevir?

pending: Meteg/gaya on ע (עיניכם), ל (לאלהיכם) and א (first אלהיכם): each is a stroke only a few pixels tall touching the vowel. Please confirm on a higher-resolution crop (at least 3x) before treating any of them as certain. The silluq under the כ of לאלהיכם is clear.
